items.known: CKV_AWS_50 X-Ray tracing is enabled for Lambda (resource aws_lambda_function.main_update)
items.remediation: Add a `tracing_config` block with `mode = "Active"` to `aws_lambda_function.main_update` to enable AWS X-Ray tracing.
